_doc: Breaking-change manifest, hand-edited (the source of truth; no generation step). install.sh --upgrade computes the window between the installed versions and the target and STOPS for confirmation on any entry with breaking:true. Fields: deploy_version, product_tag, schema_head (product alembic), breaking, downgrade_safe_to, notes.

entries.notes: First published pin. 0.1.0 images exist but are NOT consumable (mis-built keycloak theme) — never pin 0.1.1's predecessor.
Installer/compose only, no product tag move: KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL written, session lifespans re-applied after the full up, readiness gates hardened. No migration ran.
Flow change only, no product tag move: the pull token moves from the terminal to the setup form and the image pull becomes the install's first progress step. No migration ran.

Installer/form only, no product tag move: the release gate for images past product b88df95 (mints SESSION_TOKEN_PRIVATE_KEY_B64, guards the boot trio on --upgrade), the doctor replaced by the compose-health + /healthz + realm gate, and the domain-package (OPSROOM_DISTRO) field. The v0.2.0 form-flow hardening rides along. No migration ran.

Backups and restore only, no product tag move. backup.sh ships the product roles file and the age-sealed .env (7 objects, was 5) and refuses a production instance with no destination; the drill replays the product dump under ON_ERROR_STOP and proves the seal opens. install.sh --restore is implemented. MCP_BEARER=none is refused (D13). The five OPSROOM_OBJECT_STORE_* values are collected. The config pre-check runs through the image on all three paths. NOTE: a backup taken before this version carries no env.age, so --restore refuses it by name — take a fresh backup after upgrading. No migration ran.

_schema_head_note: schema_head is null on every entry so far because no entry moves OPSROOM_TAG — the product alembic head has not changed across these deploy versions. The first entry that moves the tag must record the real head.
